profile.headline: Software Developer--- NICE CXone Engineer
profile.summary:
Performing contract work as an Infrastructure Consultant - Telecommunications Engineer where my focus has been modifying NICE CXone studio scripts, administering the CXone platform by adding users, campaigns, skills, roles, etc. and assisting in training CSA's on the use of the MAX and SalesForce phone client applications. 

In the past, I performed the duties of a Call Recording support / implementation engineer who specialized in contact center voice recordings using the NICE recording platform. 

Along with supporting the NICE applications package, I am also familiar with the various Windows server platforms, as well as having a basic understanding of SQL and AWS.

Outside of work, I constantly look for learning opportunities through various online classes, or through Nice's university to stay abreast of the technologies I need to help me be my best for my clients.

Please contact me if you if you are looking to hire.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing and implementing NICE CXone IVR scripts.

positions.title: Senior Advanced Diagnostic Engineer
positions.description:
I am a Call Recording support / implementation engineer who specializes in contact center voice recordings who use the NICE recording platform.  Formerly an advance diagnostic engineer for ConvergeOne, a leading global IT services provider of collaboration and technology solutions,
I was responsible for day 2 support of various call recording platforms with a focus on the NICE platforms.  I also am a NICE certified installation engineer as well as a Calabrio certified installation engineer and worked closely with both the project manager and solutions engineer to assure successful implementations of the NICE and Calabrio product line.  My knowledge and experience allowed ConvergeOne to create innovative solutions that gave customers the experience
they deserve.

Outside of work, I constantly look for learning opportunities through various online classes, or through Nice's university to stay abreast of the technologies I need to help me be my best for my customers.

Please contact me if you are looking to hire.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description: Implemented new networks for smaller companies that did not have an IT department.  Installed servers and workstations, along with the appropriate software (Exchange, Office, or just the OS depending on situation) and networked the servers to the workstations.

positions.title: Customer Service Rep
positions.description: Field technician troubleshooting and repair / maintenance of voice recordings for public safety facilities.
